project_description: Follow-up SDD for issue #369. Extend the completed reasoning-output-preservation feature with optional bounded semantic compression of only explicitly compressible textual reasoning while keeping the original artifact authoritative and preserving exact/native/signed/opaque continuity unchanged. Reuse the completed generic auxiliary/background execution and billing infrastructure introduced by compaction-continuity-preservation, without depending on that feature's capsule/extractor semantics or compaction detector. Compression must be disabled by default, original-first, asynchronous, bounded, fail-open, capability/profile driven, shadow-tested before active replay, and structurally incapable of mutating tool/order/signature/native continuity state. This spec does not supersede the completed reasoning preservation, OpenAI Responses preservation, Codex native compaction, or compaction continuity specs; it is a brownfield follow-up that depends on their landed contracts and infrastructure.
